sources.title: Agent coordination plan
sources.locator: Status and Evaluation of the existing implementation
sources.finding: Coordinator, attention queue, structured handoffs and review surface; Steps A and B implemented, C to E not yet.

sources.title: Remote access server
sources.finding: Local HTTP and WebSocket server for phone clients with a URL token for read-only access and PIN pairing for replies, task, merge and close routes.

sources.title: Usage status bar
sources.finding: Bottom bar with rate-limit windows of each agent subscription and credit usage for pay-per-use logins.

sources.title: CI workflow
sources.finding: CI runs typecheck, lint and format checks, static checks, Semgrep security-rule tests, unit tests with a coverage floor and a coordinator test against a real pty.

sources.title: Docker sandbox image
sources.finding: Bundled Dockerfile and image tooling for per-project Docker task isolation.
